page.title: PDF reports
page.description: Create a report to keep in the child's file or to share with the team or the family.
page.privacy: Reports are created on our server and downloaded straight to this device. Nothing is published and no link is kept. Every export is recorded below.

full.title: Full Child Report
full.description: Everything in one place: the family's words, the teacher's observation, focus and plans, observations, reviews and the approved summary.

parent_questionnaire.title: Parent Questionnaire
parent_questionnaire.description: Every question of "Getting to know my child" in order, with the family's answers.

teacher_observation.title: Teacher Observation Report
teacher_observation.description: One observation cycle: all areas of development with notes, and the structured observations of the period.

current_development.title: Current Development Report
current_development.description: The approved current understanding, strengths, current focus, recent observations, activities and next steps.

intervention_plan.title: Intervention Plan
intervention_plan.description: The current goals: what we will do, how often, who, how we will know it helps and the follow-up date.

timeline.title: Timeline Report
timeline.description: What happened over a period of time, oldest first and grouped by month.

dialog.title: Export a PDF report
dialog.description: Choose the report, its language and what it includes.
dialog.languageHint: Answers stay in the language they were written in.
dialog.rangeHintTimeline: Leave empty to start from the first baseline.

rangeError.order: The start date must be before the end date.
rangeError.future: Dates cannot be in the future.

dialog.cycleHint: By default the open cycle, or the latest one.
dialog.cycleHintPlan: Choose a cycle to print only the goals that came from it.
dialog.sensitiveHint: Off by default. Include it only when it is needed.
dialog.personal: The report shows the child's name, age, kindergarten and what the family shared. Keep it in a safe place and share it only with people who need it.
dialog.downloaded: The PDF is ready in your downloads.

log.title: Export log
log.description: Who exported which report, and when. The reports themselves are not kept.
log.empty: No reports have been exported for this child yet.
